name: SD2b-the-welcome-announced
note: What happened while I was away is no news.

name: SD2b-stood-while-gone
note: A Hollow stands while its phase says so.

name: SD2b-the-ground-pulled
note: Never from under a player standing in it.

name: SD2b-found-from-afar
note: The find is said at its door.

name: SD2b-never-again
note: A find the hub did not take is said again.

name: SD2b-again-at-once
note: Again every SD_FOUND_RESEND_MS, not every frame.

name: SD2b-after-the-find
note: Never once the hub's word says found.

name: SD2b-another-slots-find
note: The find is for the record's own slot.

name: SD2b-the-fading-after-a-kill
note: A collapse after a kill is no fading.

name: SD2b-a-line-lost
old: if (!h && t - o.at < SD_LINE_WAIT_MS && !(memo && memo.s === o.rec.s && memo.none)) return;
note: A line waiting on the scan is said past the wait, never lost.

name: SD2b-an-older-word-kept
old: if (rec && w.s < rec.s) return;   // an older slot's word: the hub moved on
note: An older slot's word is no word.

name: SD2b-the-ledger-notes-a-hollow
old: if (locationIndex.get(key)?.superTier) return;   // SD2b: never a Hollow's - its life is the hub's record, not a spawn's clocks
note: A Hollow's life is the hub's record.

name: SD2b-the-ledger-clears-a-hollow
old: if (locationIndex.get(key).superTier) return;   // SD2b: a Hollow's life is the hub's record - a cleared one is not two days from gone
note: A cleared Hollow is not two days from gone.

name: SD2b-the-pixel-never-rebuilt

note: The Hollow's pixel is built again when it rises or goes on ground that stands.

name: SD2b-the-record-unheard
note: The hub's link hears the record.
